prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A group of contemporary dancers, both male and female, perform in perfect synchronization within a strikingly minimalist, all-white studio. The dancers are dressed in loose, monochromatic white outfits—tank tops, t-shirts, and pants—that blend seamlessly with the pristine, luminous environment. Their movements are expressive and dynamic, with bodies bent and arms extended in fluid, angular poses, conveying a sense of energy and unity. The background features soft, diffused lighting from large, geometric skylights above, casting gentle shadows and enhancing the ethereal, almost futuristic atmosphere. The set is devoid of any distractions, with smooth white walls and a subtle, rounded sculptural element in the center, further emphasizing the purity and focus of the scene. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, capturing the dancers mid-motion with a shallow depth of field that keeps the group in sharp focus while the background remains soft and unobtrusive. The overall style is clean, modern, and cinematic, evoking a sense of harmony, precision, and contemporary artistry.
